notes.title: THE HILLTOP FUNERAL is Coming to Tokyo Game Show!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p align="start"]I'm Luke, the producer of [i]THE HILLTOP FUNERAL[/i]![/p][p align="start"]From September 25th to 28th, we’ll be showcasing the game at the Tokyo Game Show![/p][p align="start"]Come visit us to try the demo and experience the unique fun of cooperative coffin-carrying![/p][p align="start"]The demo is still available on Steam，feel free to download and play it now![/p][p align="start"]Please don’t forget to wishlist the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540367/6546a26e5cf4c8f07d4bb37073514477f586e212.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Hilltop Funeral Demo Test is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[p]The Hilltop Funeral DEMO internal test officially begins today—we invite everyone to get a sneak peek and play now![/p][p][b]DEMO TEST DETAILS[/b][/p][p]
[b]Test Period:[/b] September 17 - September 24
[b]How to Participate:[/b] Search for "The Hilltop Funeral" on Steam, download the demo, and start playing!
[b]Reward:[/b] Participate in the test + submit your feedback in our Discord to receive a game code as a reward![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/zFsRzDYyaY"]https://discord.gg/zFsRzDYyaY[/url][/p][p align="start"]Feel free to also add The Hilltop Funeral to your Steam wishlist to stay updated on our development progress!
We look forward to your feedback—let's make the game even more fun together! [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: We are showcasing at COREBLAZER!
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p]We are excited to tell you that The Hilltop Funeral is going to be showcasing at COREBLAZER Game Fest in Shanghai from July 26th to 27th! We are really happy to show our game to more players![/p][p]Some updates on the EA version development progress:[/p][list][*][p]Chinese and Japanese localization [/p][/*][*][p]Updated display of conversations between the two characters to enhance readability [/p][/*][*][p]Updated tutorial system to allow a better learning curve [/p][/*][*][p]Updated physics behavior of tilting and balancing the coffin [/p][/*][*][p]Updated the level select screen to use a 3D layout for better visualization [/p][/*][*][p]Updated sound effects on various objects and events [/p][/*][*][p]General level design updates, new levels are currently work in progress [/p][/*][*][p]General bug fixes on physics behavior handling, failure state checks, and UI[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540367/dca062756b8f1ea4de2714ae20aa93cc14305ce9.gif"][/img][/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone that tried our demo and wishlisted our game! If you have any feedback on The Hilltop Funeral, please let us know![/p][p]See you in the next announcement :)[/p]
